newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia says budget data with mid-yr review.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia says budget data with mid-yr review.

text.p: The Australian government confirmed on Monday that it would release the November statement of Commonwealth Government Financial Transactions (CFT) in conjunction with its mid-year budget review.
However, the timing of the mid-year review's release was still uncertain with a spokesman for Finance Minister John Fahey saying that its release this week was a possibility only.
The government had said previously that the review would be released before the last week of January.
